class.name: OpenWorldTree3D
class.brief_description: Renders many static trees with variant- and distance-based MultiMesh buckets.
class.description: [OpenWorldTree3D] renders one [OpenWorldTreeSpecies] using compact records from [OpenWorldTreePlacementData]. Every enabled tree is assigned to a variation and LOD MultiMesh bucket. Buckets are rebuilt only when assignments change. This node handles static rendering and queries; it intentionally does not create collision bodies, perform procedural scattering, or simulate cutting and falling.

method.name: get_closest_instance_id
method.description: Returns the stable ID of the closest enabled tree within [param max_distance], or [code]-1[/code]. This initial implementation performs a linear CPU search.

method.name: get_instance_global_transform
method.description: Returns the world transform of the tree with [param instance_id].

method.name: get_rendered_instance_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently rendered instances across all MultiMesh buckets.

method.name: rebuild_tree_instances
method.description: Recreates all render buckets and repopulates their instances.

method.name: set_tree_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the tree with [param instance_id]. A future harvesting system can disable a static instance before spawning an interactive scene.

members.member: Optional LOD camera. The viewport's active 3D camera is used when this path is empty or invalid.
